protocol: Reserved independent Emeryville street; original seen bus cutout; identical paired pixels/positions; classifiers and validation-selected thresholds frozen before evaluation.
ground_truth: Any inserted foreground alpha>32 pixel per region, used only for evaluation. Alpha>20 and previous coarse rectangle rule are also logged by the shared renderer.
complete_scene_definition: At least one correct marked tile and zero false marked tiles; this does not require marking every target-overlapping tile.

logistic.primary_ground_truth: any target alpha >32 pixel in tile

grover_probability_summary.semantics: Ideal exact-statevector probabilities after the browser first-peak iteration rule, not sampled outcomes. Empty marks give a uniform theoretical distribution at zero rounds; the UI returns no search result, so a separate effective mass treats those scenes as zero.
grover_probability_summary.formula: (|T intersect S|/M) sin^2((2k+1)theta) + (|T minus S|/(N-M)) cos^2((2k+1)theta), theta=asin(sqrt(M/N)); uniform for M=0 or N.
